body:
I found why "all open items" is not converging, and it is not review capacity. Filed BUG-1470, draft/High.

SIX SPECS CARRY VERDICTS AND NONE HAS HAD A DRAIN RUN SINCE. Counting RunStarted events after each spec's newest verdict recorded_at:

    TASK-1289   verdict 06:10Z   runs after: 0   (eleven hours)
    STORY-1350  verdict 13:28Z   runs after: 0
    TASK-1298   verdict 14:39Z   runs after: 0
    BUG-1297    verdict 15:08Z   runs after: 0
    BUG-1288    verdict 17:04Z   runs after: 0

BUG-1286 is excluded rather than counted as zero — its verdict has no recorded_at so the comparison is impossible, and it did in fact run (stale-base-conflict at 17:04:55Z). That exclusion is itself BUG-1467 biting the measurement.

Meanwhile the same drain opened PR-2024 for BUG-1432 and holds fourteen more queued members. Capacity was never the constraint. New work flows; reviewed work stops.

TWO MECHANISMS, and the second is the one I would fix first.

A shelved spec is needs-attention, which the drain's eligibility correctly reports as needs-triage and skips. Fine on its own — an unattended drain should not re-drive untriaged work. But nothing else drives them, so "skipped pending triage" becomes "parked indefinitely" whenever the triaging seat is busy. You have been busy all day.

The worse one: `aida queue rework <ID>` WITHOUT `--work` produces a state nothing can pick up. It flips to InProgress and queues, per its documented table. With no session claiming it, the spec is InProgress with no lease, and the pickup path then REFUSES it — "InProgress but no local lease holds it". `aida ps` calls that shape flag-only.

I hit this live while acting on the finding. I requeued BUG-1288, BUG-1297 and TASK-1298 with bare `queue rework`; all three went flag-only, none entered the drain's member list, and they only became pickable after `aida edit --status approved`. They are approved and batched now.

That means the metadata-only mode of the recovery verb — the form that reads as the safe choice for a seat that wants the DRAIN to do the work rather than launching a session itself — silently produces a spec nothing will touch, and reports success. If you have been using the bare form anywhere today, those specs are sitting in flag-only.

ON THE THREE I REQUEUED. I read their hold reasons first and all three want rework rather than a decision: #1999's candidate gate hiding needs-attention specs, #2006's prose-matched ambiguous/not-found distinction, and your changes-requested on #2014 overriding the drain reviewer's approval. I left TASK-1289 alone because you said it needs a design decision rather than another round, and I left STORY-1350 alone because you already requeued it once and got a rebase-only round — requeuing again without addressing why would just reproduce that.

Disposition on those two is yours. So is BUG-1470's.

ONE MEASUREMENT NOTE. The question "which specs have a verdict with no subsequent run, and for how long?" took a hand-written pass over events.jsonl plus the verdict files. That is the kind of question the rework queue should answer directly, and I have put it in BUG-1470's acceptance.
